Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Navin Chawla
 Order
1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.

2. This application has been filed under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (in short, 'Cr.P.C.') praying for grant of interim bail for a period of 15 days in FIR No.476/2019 registered at the Police Station: Tilak Nagar under Sections 306/376 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860,
on the ground that the applicant has unfortunately lost his grandmother on 06.03.2024.
3.

The application is opposed by the learned APP while submitting that even on an earlier occasion when the applicant was released on interim bail, the main witness had turned hostile and the father and the uncle of the applicant allegedly assaulted and molested the complainant, resulting in an FIR being registered against them.
She submits that the applicant is also involved in two other FIRs alleging serious offences involving harm to property and persons as also house This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 16/03/2024 at 02:48:59 trespass.

She further submits that keeping in view the conduct of the applicant, this Court had dismissed the applicant's bail application vide order dated 19.09.2023 passed in Bail Appln.
1247/2023, titled Karan Chandela v. The State (Govt. of NCT of Delhi).
4. I have considered the submissions made by the learned counsels for the parties.

the prayer of the applicant for being released on interim bail for a period of 15 days is rejected.

sentences.text: 6. The learned counsel for the applicant submits that one of the important last ceremonies-Tehrvi of the deceased grandmother of the applicant is scheduled to take place on 17.03.2024.

7. In view of the same, the Jail Superintendent is directed to ensure that the applicant Karan Chandela is allowed to attend this ceremony, while being in custody, on 17.03.2024, from 9.00 a.m.
to 6.00 p.m.
The police officials accompanying the applicant shall be in a civil attire.
8. The application is disposed of in the above terms.
9. Copy of the order be sent to the Jail Superintendent for information and necessary compliance.

10. Dasti.
